subject.title: [BUG]: Browser tool: `snapshot` returns page content before scroll, ignoring viewport position

question: Should OpenClaw change browser snapshot semantics to be visible-viewport scoped after scroll, or add a separate visible-viewport read while keeping the current full AI/ARIA snapshot behavior?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but choosing the model-facing browser snapshot contract affects compatibility for existing full-page snapshot workflows and requires live proof across the supported browser backends.

options.title: Add explicit visible-viewport read
options.body: Introduce a visible-viewport snapshot or mode with scroll metadata and keep current full/raw snapshot behavior as an explicit escape hatch.

options.title: Change snapshot default
options.body: Make browser snapshot itself viewport-scoped and require users who need full-page state to opt into a separate full/raw mode.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Leave snapshot as a full-tree read and document screenshot, selector, or efficient-mode workarounds for below-the-fold verification.

recommendation.title: Add explicit visible-viewport read
recommendation.body: Introduce a visible-viewport snapshot or mode with scroll metadata and keep current full/raw snapshot behavior as an explicit escape hatch.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across browser snapshot behavior, observed browser state, and the public browser docs contract.
